assertion.statement: The actual integral Kummer Selmer complex C_K is identified with its Z2-derived dual shifted by minus three, once its perfect coefficient pairing and exact local orthogonality are supplied.
assertion.objects: The bounded perfect integral Z2 complex C_K of the fixed imaginary quadratic K and the actual Tate lattice T2(E).
assertion.hypotheses: The retained integral perfect pairing, compatible local diagrams and exact orthogonality satisfy the source hypotheses. Finite rational torsion, H0=0, the computed torsion in H1 and full Selmer corank one are separate actual inputs.
assertion.quantifiers: The actual C_K under these stated conditions.
assertion.parameter_range: Integral Z2 coefficients; K has no real places.
assertion.uniformity: An exact derived comparison, without a numerical estimate.
assertion.constants: No division by two or torsion order.
assertion.normalizations: C_K is equivalent to RHom_Z2(C_K,Z2)[-3], with actual Kummer local conditions.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This source use does not itself prove finite rational torsion, the H1 torsion identification, perfectness, or corank one. Ext and rank calculations are subsequent local algebra.
assertion.limit_order: Establish the integral paired local conditions and source hypotheses, invoke duality, then use the displayed cohomology and universal coefficient calculations.

use.reason: Supplies the integral duality used before the existing Ext and rank calculation.

supplier.statement: Nekovar 6.3.4 gives the shift-three Selmer duality comparison, with its error triangle; exact orthogonality makes the comparison an isomorphism. The cohomology spectral sequence is described in 6.3.5.

publication.title: Selmer Complexes
publication.corrections: Exact retained independent A038/A044/A045 source/application review reused; source constructions and limits remain separate.

available_assertion.objects: Paired complexes over a coefficient ring with dualizing complex, and orthogonal local conditions satisfying Nekovar 6.2.5(A) or (B).
available_assertion.hypotheses: Retain actual perfect coefficient pairing, compatible local maps/isotropy homotopies, bounded perfect models, and the hypotheses of the stated source theorem; these constructions are separate inputs.
available_assertion.quantifiers: For each pair satisfying 6.2.5(A) or (B), perfect duality and the required local orthogonality data.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Prime2 included; imaginary K for the global uses here, with no omitted real correction.
available_assertion.uniformity: Compatibility with the stated maps and coefficient changes, not new numerical bounds.
available_assertion.constants: No new quantitative constant, field extension, or division by coefficient-group order.
available_assertion.normalizations: Coefficient-valued duality, full degree-zero local torsion, and actual conjugation pullback; not an unqualified ordinary self-dual nonquadratic twist.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No contraction, perfection, finite Sha, or derivative relation is inferred merely from citing duality.
available_assertion.limit_order: Construct actual paired coefficients and local diagrams before invoking the source theorem.
available_assertion.statement: Nekovar 6.3.4 gives the shift-three Selmer duality comparison, with its error triangle; exact orthogonality makes the comparison an isomorphism. The cohomology spectral sequence is described in 6.3.5.
